lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Four hundred and one shapes out of that sand in eleven days, and every one of them is the same man carrying the same length of rebar.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It is not a man. It is a great many men, standing in the same place.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Then somebody buried a crew out there, and the ground has been trying to give them back ever since. I'd want to know whose crew before I went down.
